metadata.description: Help a research team design a working elabFTW data schema with an AI partner — and give that AI the operating manual to work the schema correctly afterwards.

plugins.name: elabftw-rdm
plugins.description: elabftw-mcp (generic operating manual: entity model, MCP tools, what elabFTW does NOT do + the workarounds), elabftw-schema-init (interactive workshop that designs the lab's schema), labschema (the generated per-lab structural contract). Backed by FAIR, ALCOA+, DCC, ISA, PROV reference docs.
